price.title: Price
price.intro: From 18 August 2026 and on site, the last price period applies:
storno: Until 30 June 2026 we refund 100 % of the amount paid.
From 1 July to 31 July 2026 we refund 50 %.
From 1 August 2026 the registration fee is non-refundable.
price.transfer_body: A transfer to a substitute is possible at any time up to the start of the event and is free of charge — send us an e-mail saying that you cannot come and give the variable symbol (payment reference) of the player you are passing the fee on to. We will strike you off the list and reassign the payment. The financial settlement takes place between the two of you.

rules.title: Rules at a glance
rules.intro: This is a summary of the most important points. But ignorance of the rules is no excuse — read their full text before the game.
main: Safety comes first.
The organiser's decision stands.
Weapons must pass approval.
Stop using a damaged weapon or shield immediately. After repair it must pass approval by an organiser again.
The costume affects the number of lives (2–4).
Combat is fought to the large hit zones.
A melee weapon hit = 1 life, a hit by an arrow or a crossbow bolt = 2 lives.
A hit is acknowledged by the person who was hit.
On request, state truthfully how many lives you have left.
Every strike must be delivered with a visible swing.
Every strike must be controlled and pulled. Blows must not land at full force.
Two-handed weapons are wielded with both hands.
No punches, kicks, blows with the weapon's pommel, leg sweeps, throwing people down, locks, wrestling or other physical attacks.
Do not ram or push into an opponent with a shield, especially not at a run.
Do not abuse physical superiority to shove or push an opponent back.
There is no fighting in dangerous places.
Watch the terrain, both yours and your opponent's. Warn a retreating opponent if they are getting into danger, and break off the attack.
If an opponent is injured, break off the fight immediately, give the necessary help and call a medic.
If a hit hurts, you may place a hand on your head — it means “I am out of the game”.
You must not enter the battle under the influence of alcohol or other intoxicating substances.
Enter the battle only if you are physically and mentally fit to fight safely. An organiser may decide that you are unfit.
A costume is required for the whole event.
The organiser has the final say. Do not argue with them.
If an organiser forbids something or does not approve it, do not go around their decision through another organiser.
There is no smoking in the forest or anywhere in the game area. Smoking is therefore banned during the game.
Light a fire only in places designated, prepared or expressly approved by the organisers.
Do not interfere significantly with nature without the organiser's consent.
You came to have fun, not to argue.
Be considerate of nature and of the people around you.
We play fair. Anyone who does not know what that means stays at home.
Ignorance of the rules is no excuse.
No means no. Respect other people's personal boundaries.
Physical contact beyond ordinary safe combat is based on the consent of those involved.
rules.stop_lead: In a situation that threatens health or safety, anyone may call “Red STOP” (in Czech „Rudá STOP“, which is what is shouted on site). As soon as you hear it, the game and the fighting stop immediately.
rules.stop_when_h: Use Red STOP above all when:
stop_when: an immediate safety problem is looming
the game has to be stopped at once because of health or safety
rules.stop_after: Once Red STOP has been called, do not continue fighting, check the situation and follow the organisers' instructions.
hit_yes: arms from the torso to the wrists
legs from the torso to the ankles
hit_no: arms from the wrists down, inclusive
legs from the ankles down, inclusive
hit_notes: Invalid hit zones must not be attacked deliberately.
You must not use invalid hit zones as cover on purpose.
If a single hit lands on a valid and an invalid hit zone at once, the hit does not count.
rules.death_h: When you lose your last life
rules.death_lead: At 0 lives you are mortally wounded.
death: if it is safe, you collapse / lie down
as a mortally wounded character you no longer interfere with the game
if you have a resurrection in the current game phase, move quietly, with a hand behind your head, to your army standard / resurrection spot
if there is no resurrection, you stay mortally wounded in a safe place
if you risk being trampled or are in other danger, you may move a little to the side
rules.death_signal: A hand behind the head = I am moving out of the fight / to a resurrection and I am no longer taking part in the engagement.

weapons.note: cannot be combined with another weapon
in this combination the spear may be 150 cm at most
see the mandatory head protection below

rules.weapons_note1: Every weapon must pass approval by an organiser before the game.
rules.weapons_note2: Meeting the size limit alone does not mean automatic approval. Safety, handling, workmanship, condition and the look of the weapon also decide.
rules.shield_lead: Do you have a shield with any dimension exceeding 60 cm? When fighting with such a shield you must have functional head protection.
rules.approval_h: A weapon is not approved just because it has the right length.
approval: it must have no sharp edges or dangerous protrusions
it must have no loose parts
it must be safe to handle
it must match the theme of the event
it must look like a weapon, not like a distracting modern or off-setting prop
an organiser may reject a weapon even during the event if it gets damaged or becomes dangerous
rules.approval_warn: A damaged weapon or shield must not be used in combat. After repair it must pass approval again.
rules.archers_h: Coming with a bow or a crossbow?
archers: every arrow / bolt is approved individually
the minimum is 10 approved arrows / bolts per shooter
if at least 10 arrows are not approved, the bow will not be approved either
a damaged arrow must not be used
shoot only your own ammunition or the ammunition of someone you have agreed it with
do not take other people's arrows home with you
after the game, other people's arrows are collected / returned according to the organisers' instructions
rules.archers_note: The detailed dimensions of arrow heads and the requirements for shafts, fletchings and arrow construction are in the full rules.
rules.archers_cta: Rules for bows, crossbows and arrows
safe: no kicks, punches, wrestling or throwing people down
do not push into people with your shield
do not drive an opponent into dangerous terrain
if a hit hurts: a hand on the head = “I am out of the game”
in case of injury, help immediately and call a medic
nature: fires only in fire pits prepared or approved by the organisers
your own fire pit only with express consent
no felling of trees or shrubs
waste belongs in the bags provided / designated places
there is no smoking in the forest or anywhere in the game area
after you leave, no rubbish, holes or uncleared fire pits may remain behind you
rules.cta_lead: This is only a quick summary. To take part in the game, read the full rules.

story.title: The story of the 2026 edition
paragraphs: After the fighting in South Ithilien and in the marshes there, the forces of the Dark Lord managed to push forward as far as Pelargir. A number of smaller skirmishes between the companies of both sides took place here. They fought in the woods and the hills, but also on ships on the river Anduin.

Both sides tried to gain as many supplies as possible, with which to sustain the main host of the attackers before the gates, or the defenders behind the walls respectively. The forces of the Dark Lord managed to plunder the wide country around the city considerably, yet in the final clash between the scouting companies they were defeated. Even so, they managed to deliver the amassed supplies to the besieging army.

The attack will have to be led both by land and by water. The corsairs of Umbar work day and night on new ships that would be able to overcome the city's defences. Gondor and its allies are not idle either, and thanks to the materials gained from the surrounding country they are improving the fortifications and preparing for the hard times that are yet to come.

items.text: An atmospheric or camp role away from the main battle lines.

items.text: You are part of the game and the atmosphere, but you do not fight.
